name: Budapest
dek: Belterület, the inner-city station. Pestszentlőrinc was not merged.
paragraphs: Budapest Belterület is WMO 12840, height 153 m, position 47°30′40″N, 19°01′41″E. The Hungary sheet uses the same station. Pestszentlőrinc, WMO 12843, has its own file and is not averaged in.

The highest average high in the table is 28.9 °C, in August. The lowest average low is -1.2 °C, in January. The wettest month by the precipitation column is June, at 60 mm, and the driest is February, at 30.2 mm.

climate.caption: Station: Budapest Belterület, WMO 12840. Not Pestszentlőrinc.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed; a value printed with no leading zero, such as -.3, is shown as -0.3. Budapest Pestszentlőrinc (WMO 12843) is a separate Budapest file and was not averaged with Belterület.

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type C and F, 230 V, 50 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Hungary at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: Section 25(2) of the Hungarian highway code, Decree 1/1975 (II. 5.) KPM-BM (KRESZ), in the consolidated text on Nemzeti Jogtár, says a vehicle travels on the carriageway on the right-hand side in its direction of travel, keeping as far to the right as road and traffic conditions allow, except when overtaking or passing an obstacle. Nemzeti Jogtár is a commercial consolidation, not the official gazette.

tipping.label: Tipping
tipping.detail: Visit Hungary says the usual amount of a tip is 10%, for cabs, restaurants, and so on, and that staff prefer a cash tip when you pay by card. It says a 10–15% service charge added to the bill is starting to spread, and that if it is included you do not need to tip.

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Hungary, last reviewed August 25, 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Forint and the code HUF for Hungary.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab and zone1970.tab each give Hungary one row, Europe/Budapest. There is no second zone for the country in either file.

entry.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Hungary, consular service
entry.note: The foreign ministry's consular information site. We do not restate a visa rule.
